title: 7 Best AI Interview Copilots Compared (2026) — Amigo
description: Objective comparison of the top AI interview copilot tools in 2026: Amigo, Final Round AI, LockedIn AI, Verve AI, Parakeet AI, HuddleMate, and Interview Coder. Features, pricing, and stealth compared.

mainEntity.name: What is an AI interview copilot?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI interview copilot is a desktop application that listens to your job interview in real time — capturing both audio and your screen — and surfaces suggested answers or hints through an invisible overlay that is undetectable to your interviewer. Tools like Amigo, Final Round AI, LockedIn AI, Verve AI, Parakeet AI, HuddleMate, and Interview Coder fall into this category.

mainEntity.name: Which AI interview copilot is the best in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amigo leads on stealth (hidden in Task Manager and Activity Monitor, not just screen share), uniquely offers a Buddy feature for live human + AI collaboration, supports both coding and behavioral interviews, responds in under 0.3 seconds, and is priced 30% lower than competitors. It is used by 200,000+ job seekers globally.

Most AI interview copilots hide from screen share but remain visible in Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS). Amigo is the only tool that is also hidden from system process monitors, making it the most undetectable option available.

mainEntity.name: Do AI interview copilots work for coding interviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amigo, Final Round AI, LockedIn AI, Verve AI, and Interview Coder all support coding interview platforms like HackerRank, LeetCode, and CoderPad. Parakeet AI and HuddleMate focus primarily on verbal / behavioral interviews.

mainEntity.name: How do AI interview copilot prices compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing varies. Final Round AI, LockedIn AI, Verve AI, and Interview Coder all use monthly subscription plans. Amigo is the only pay-as-you-go option — credits start at $15 for 2 hours, never expire, and approximately 30% cheaper than comparable subscription plans. Amigo also offers free credits on sign-up with no credit card required.

mainEntity.name: Is it ethical to use an AI interview copilot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using AI tools to prepare and practice for interviews is widely accepted. Real-time assistants operate in a gray area that varies by employer. Amigo is designed as a performance enhancement tool, similar to using notes in certain interview formats. Users are responsible for understanding the policies of companies they interview with.
